system.description:
All willing creatures in range is imbued with heroic bravery, becoming immune to either the Demoralized or Shaken condition, for the duration. Pick one when this jutsu is cast.

Additionally, affected creatures gains 2d6+4 temporary hit points. When the Genjutsu ends, the target loses any remaining temporary hit points. At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the temporary hit points gained by 1d6.
